documents.title: Switch the sidebar between All, Groups and Favorites
documents.content: Use the three buttons at the top of the left sidebar: All shows the full menu, Groups shows module groups, and Favorites shows favorite actions. The selected view is highlighted and changes immediately without opening Settings. Beside them, the Save button saves the view you are looking at as your default, so the sidebar opens on it on later visits (the button looks filled when the current view is already your default, and a message confirms each save), and the pin control pins or unpins the sidebar. The same default can also be chosen in Settings under Sidebar Layout. Settings and Help also remain at the bottom of the sidebar.

documents.title: Filter and sort the All sidebar view
documents.content: In the sidebar's All view, use Filter menu to find a destination by text. Escape or the clear button empties the filter. The A–Z and Z–A buttons sort the full menu accordingly. Save Changes saves menu-order changes. The Shortcuts section can be expanded or collapsed separately.

documents.title: How Workflows affect the sidebar Workspace group
documents.content: Workflows at /workflows are named, ordered sets of destinations. Applying a workflow as the active standard changes the destinations shown in the sidebar's Workspace group. Without an active workflow, Ogeemo uses its default Workspace destinations. Saving, applying, or deleting workflows refreshes the sidebar without requiring a page reload.
